bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
dbs="$(docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -E '(^|[-_])(postgres|postgresql|db)([-_]|$)' || true)"
test -n "$dbs" || exit 51
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$dbs" | wc -l)" -eq 1 || exit 52
db="$dbs"
docker exec "$db" sh -lc 'command -v psql >/dev/null 2>&1' || exit 53
docker exec "$db" sh -lc 'psql -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -Atqc "SELECT count(*) FROM posting_topics WHERE enabled=TRUE AND verified_at IS NOT NULL AND title ~ '\''ビデオ.?チャット'\'' AND chat_id IN (-1002373696859,-1003770334893);"' >/tmp/gace-video-topic-db-count.txt || exit 54
test -s /tmp/gace-video-topic-db-count.txt || exit 55
echo POSTGRES_TOPIC_LEDGER_READABLE
